reviewer: Codex direct inspection of native QGIS PNGs

findings.overview: Roof candidates cover the region but are not independent building identities or a complete inventory.
findings.CAMPUS_NORTH: Many real roofs discovered. Initial tall-tree false candidates reduced after height-only routing correction. Some platforms and roof-plane splits remain.
findings.CAMPUS_SOUTH: Actual roofs missing from primary Class6-context layer remain possible in unknown. Roof planes/attachments split. Cemetery objects include false candidates.
findings.EAST_RESIDENTIAL: Many houses located; roof hips/planes are split and some neighbors share ambiguous boundaries. No completeness verdict.
findings.T14: Main roof discovered automatically; edge appendages persist. A separate red candidate on the amphitheater/paved structure is not an accepted building.
findings.T21: One articulated roof is split into multiple observations. Eastern platform included; overlapping roof-plane candidates. Not fixed as a single cadastral body.
findings.T24: Main red roof and rounded projection separated. Small edge notches persist. Surrounding tree candidates were rerouted to unknown, not deleted.
findings.T29: L-shaped hall and terminal wing located, but overlapping observations and southern ledge/pavement contamination remain.

display_fix.T07: Before image had missing western edges; after vector-above-raster order the full existing closed outline is visible.
display_fix.B00010: Full unchanged outline visible after order correction.

ground_backup_T10: Three-panel image inspected. Two assumed inset scenarios are clearly labelled, not measured wall footprints.
next_required_quality_step: Evaluate an aerial roof/building semantic proposal model and evidence-based roof boundary fitting on fixed annotated windows. Do not use unaccepted predictions/GMW mixed geometry as clean labels.
